name: Integrated Life Sciences PhD entry program

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 completed application
deadlines.note: All components, including verified English scores/waiver and ILS supplemental application, due by the deadline. Allow 2–4 weeks for English verification.

english.toefl: 80 overall with Speaking/Writing 20 (before Jan 21, 2026); 4.5 overall with Speaking/Writing 4 (on/after Jan 22, 2026)
english.note: IELTS no band below 6.0. DET not accepted. UGA Intensive English Level 6 can satisfy proficiency. Qualifying U.S./English-primary-country degrees or current enrollment with at least one year at a regionally accredited U.S. institution and strong performance may permit exemption; departments can still require scores. ILS recommends TOEFL Speaking 22 or IELTS Speaking 6.5; admitted applicants with lower speaking scores must take first-year English proficiency courses. Official scores or exemption must be verified before the deadline.

applicationFee.note: ILS offers no departmental waivers. Graduate School offers limited documented qualifying-program waivers; ILS FAQ explicitly mentions certain international exchange programs. Confirm the current qualifying category before selecting a waiver. Additional applications cost $25; incorrect waiver selection can cancel the application.

documents: Verified English proficiency scores or exemption if required
ILS supplemental application: three interdisciplinary groups, three departments and three faculty of interest
requirements.note: Select Athens / Doctoral / PHD, Integrated Life Sciences [PHD_ILSC]. No mentor agreement needed before applying; first-semester three lab rotations precede adviser and degree-program selection. No writing sample or publication copies required. Statement should cover reasons, research interests, scholarly experience and special circumstances or perceived deficiencies. Evaluation is holistic; published admitted-student GPA averages are not minima. Letters may arrive after initial submission but all materials must meet the final deadline.

funding.note: First-semester full funding with no teaching; FAQ guarantees stipend years 2–5 at the chosen program's standard. Published $34,738 stipend is for Fall 2025, not 2027; units reset rates in year 2. Tuition page says remitted in year 1 and thereafter with RA/TA; FAQ says reduced, so confirm exact tuition/remaining charges. Health insurance is subsidized. Subsequent support can be RA/TA or fellowships; teaching depends on department/adviser.

international.note: Accredited undergraduate degree and Graduate School country-specific credentials required.

timeline.interviews: Screening December/early January; international interviews by video in January/February; domestic recruitment late January/February. Offers follow interviews.
